children: Savills plc, the international real estate advisor, is pleased to announce the appointment of John Nixon as an additional Independent Non-Executive Director with effect from 17 September 2026.

John is currently a non-executive director of Virtu Financial (appointed 2015), one of the world's leading electronic trading and market-making firms, and is a member of the U.S. Advisory Board of Temasek Holdings (appointed 2018).

John brings extensive experience as a commercial business leader having provided strategic leadership during a period of significant transformation in global financial markets, most recently as an Executive Director of ICAP plc (2002-15), prior to which he was a Partner at Veritas Capital Management (1998-2002). Before that John held various roles at Tullett & Tokyo Forex International from 1978, latterly as Chief Executive (1995-97).
There is no further information which would require disclosure under 9.6.13R of the Listing Rules of the UK Listing Authority in respect of John Nixon.

Commenting on the appointment Stacey Cartwright, Chair of Savills plc said : "We are delighted to welcome John to the Board. He brings a wealth of experience from senior leadership and board roles, together with a strong track record of helping businesses navigate periods of change and growth. His commercial perspective and governance experience will be valuable additions to the Board as Savills continues to pursue its long-term strategic objectives."
